title: •Toryn Farr
caption: •Toryn Farr (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. {maintenance} cards may not participate in battle the turn they are deployed and are placed out of play when they leave the table.
lore: Chief Controller at Echo Command. Responsible for communicating orders to the troops. Personally gives firing orders to Ion Cannon Control.
